body.zh-Hans: 图像仍然存在，但它们与记忆和意义之间的联系正在消失。
body.en: Images remain, but their connection to memory and meaning is fading.

body.zh-Hans: 读取行列线索，修复真实受损区域，并保存可以再次制作的作品蓝图。
body.en: Read the clues, repair damaged regions, and preserve buildable blueprints.

body.zh-Hans: 数字表示连续色块长度，字母符号帮助你在不依赖颜色时辨认它们。教学不会写入作品进度。
body.en: Numbers show run lengths; symbols identify colors without relying on color. The tutorial never writes Artwork progress.

subtitle.zh-Hans: 从谜题与作品修复开始

body.zh-Hans: 进入修复室，逐块恢复作品并亲手获得蓝图。
body.en: Enter restoration, recover every Fragment, and earn its Blueprint.

body.zh-Hans: 先查看拼豆工坊；你仍可随时切换到修复室。
body.en: Open the bead workshop first; restoration remains available at any time.

body.zh-Hans: 一座用于验证完整修复流程的合成馆藏。
body.en: A synthetic collection for validating the full restoration flow.

subtitle.zh-Hans: 第一章 · 留存的色层

body.zh-Hans: 白蚀留下了图像，却切断了它们与意义之间的联系。
body.en: The Whitening left images behind while severing their meaning.

subtitle.zh-Hans: 开发作品 · 双阶段修复样本

body.zh-Hans: 画面边缘仍保存着颜料，中央记忆层需要重新连接。
body.en: Pigment survives at the edge; the central memory layer must be reconnected.

completionBody.zh-Hans: 整幅作品已恢复，制作蓝图与亲手修复印章现已可用。
completionBody.en: The complete artwork is restored; its Blueprint and restorer seal are now available.

body.zh-Hans: 恢复围绕空白核心的蓝色与金色颜料。
body.en: Restore blue and gold pigment surrounding the empty center.

completionBody.zh-Hans: 第一处受损区域已写入修复档案；作品仍有一处裂隙。
completionBody.en: The first region is recorded; one fracture remains.

body.zh-Hans: 重新固定作品边缘最后一枚蓝色锚点。
body.en: Reattach the final blue anchor at the artwork edge.

completionBody.zh-Hans: 最后一个修复片段已归档。
completionBody.en: The final repair Fragment is archived.
